text_en: The storm, situated about 645 miles (1040 km) west of the Cape Verde islands, is likely to dissipate before threatening any land areas, forecasters say.

text_en: 250 years later, Guinness has grown to a global business that turns over 10 billion euros (US$14.7 billion) every year.

text_en: Jonny Reid, co-driver for the A1GP New Zealand team, today made history by driving the fastest over the 48-year-old Auckland Harbour Bridge, New Zealand, legally.

text: Cafodd heddlu Seland Newydd drafferth i ddefnyddio'u gynnau radar cyflymder i weld pa mor gyflym roedd Mr Reid yn mynd oherwydd pa mor isel mae Black Beauty, a'r unig dro y llwyddodd yr heddlu i fesur Mr Reid oedd pan arafodd i 160km yr awr.
text_en: The New Zealand police had trouble using their speed radar guns to see how fast Mr Reid was going because of how low Black Beauty is, and the only time the police managed to clock Mr Reid was when he slowed down to 160km/h.

text_en: In the last 3 months, over 80 arrestees were released from the Central Booking facility without being formally charged.

text_en: In April this year, a temporary restaining order was issued by Judge Glynn against the facility to enforce the release of those held more than 24 hours after their intake who did not receive a hearing by a court commissioner.

text: Bydd y comisiynydd yn gosod mechnïaeth, os caiff ei ddyfarnu, ac yn ffurfioli'r cyhuddiadau a gyflwynir gan y swyddog arestio. Bydd y cyhuddiadau wedyn yn cael eu cofnodi yn system gyfrifiadur y dalaith lle mae'r achos yn cael ei olrhain.
text_en: The commissioner sets bail, if granted, and formalizes the charges filed by the arresting officer. The charges are then entered into the state's computer system where the case is tracked.

text: Mae'r gwrandawiad hefyd yn nodi'r dyddiad ar gyfer hawl yr un dan amheuaeth i gael treial cyflym.
text_en: The hearing also marks the date for the suspect’s right to a speedy trial.

text_en: Peter Costello, Australian treasurer and the man most likely to succeed Prime Minister John Howard as Liberal party leader has thrown his support behind a nuclear power industry in Australia.

text_en: Mr Costello said that when nuclear power generation becomes economically viable, Australia should pursue its use.

text_en: These bosses had been reined in by Provenzano when he put an end to the Riina-driven war against the state that claimed the lives of Mafia crusaders Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino in 1992."

text_en: The famous Greek lawyers, Sakis Kechagioglou and George Nikolakopoulos have been imprisoned in the Athens' jail of Korydallus, as they were found guilty of graft and corruption.

text_en: As a result of this, a big scandal within the Greek legal community has been raised through the exposure of illegal actions that judges, lawyers, solicitors and attorneys have done during the previous years.

text_en: A few weeks ago, after the information published by the journalist Makis Triantafylopoulos in his popular Television show "Zoungla" in Alpha TV, the member of Parliament and lawyer, Petros Mantouvalos was abdicated as members of his office had been involved in illegal graft and corruption.

text_en: Moreover, top judge Evangelos Kalousis is imprisoned as he found guilty of corruption and degenerate behaviour.

text_en: Roberts flatly refused to say about when he believes life begins, an important question when considering the ethics of abortion, saying that it would be unethical to comment on the specifics of likely cases.

text_en: He did, however, reiterate his earlier statement that Roe v. Wade was the "settled law of the land", emphasizing the importance of consistent Supreme Court rulings.

text_en: This is the first time a conviction has been gained using the legislation enacted in 2003 to curb bulk e-mail, aka spam, from unsolicited distribution into users mailboxes.

text_en: Since then, the Brazilian has featured in 53 matches for the club in all competitions and has scored 24 goals.

text_en: Dr. Lee also expressed his concern about reports that children in Turkey have now become infected with the A(H5N1) avian influenza virus without becoming ill.

text_en: There is concern that patients may continue to infect more people by going through their daily routines if the flu symptoms remain mild.

text: Dywedodd Leslie Aun, llefarydd dros Sefydliad Komen, fod y sefydliad wedi mabwysiadu rheol newydd sydd ddim yn caniatáu grantiau na chyllid i gael ei ddyfarnu i sefydliadau sydd o dan ymchwiliad cyfreithiol.
text_en: Leslie Aun, a spokesperson for the Komen Foundation, said the organization adopted a new rule that does not allow grants or funding to be awarded to organizations that are under legal investigation.

text_en: Komen's policy disqualified Planned Parenthood due to a pending investigation on how Planned Parenthood spends and reports its money that is being conducted by Representative Cliff Stearns.

text: Mae Sterans yn ymchwilio i a yw trethi'n cael eu defnyddio i gyllido erthyliadau trwy Planned Parenthood yn ei rôl fel cadeirydd yr Is-bwyllgor Goruchwylio ac Ymchwiliadau sydd o dan ymbarél Pwyllgor Ynni a Masnach y Tŷ.
text_en: Stearns is investigating whether taxes are used to fund abortions through Planned Parenthood in his role as chairman of the Oversight and Investigations Subcommittee, which is under the umbrella of the House Energy and Commerce Committee.

text: Enillodd cyn-lywodraethwr Massachusetts, Mitt Romney, ragetholiad arlywyddol Plaid Weriniaethol Florida ddydd Mawrth gyda dros 46 y cant o'r bleidlais.
text_en: Former Massachusetts governor Mitt Romney won the Florida Republican Party presidential primary election on Tuesday with over 46 percent of the vote.

text_en: As a winner-takes-all state, Florida awarded all fifty of its delegates to Romney, pushing him ahead as the front-runner for the Republican Party nomination.

text: Dywedodd trefnwyr y gwrthdystiad fod tua 100,000 o bobl wedi dod mewn dinasoedd yn yr Almaen fel Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, a Hanover.

text_en: In Berlin, police estimated 6,500 protestors.

text_en: Animal Liberation and the Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (RSPCA) are again calling for the mandatory installation of CCTV cameras in all Australian abattoirs.

text: Dywedodd prif arolygydd RSCPA New South Wales, David O'Shannessy, wrth yr ABC y dylai gwyliadwriaeth ac archwiliadau o ladd-dai fod yn gyffredin yn Awstralia.
text_en: RSPCA New South Wales chief inspector David O'Shannessy told the ABC that surveillance and inspections of abattoirs should be commonplace in Australia.

text_en: "The CCTV would certainly send a strong signal to those people working with animals that their welfare is of the highest priority."

text: Adroddodd Swyddfa Dywydd Gwlad yr Iâ hefyd ddim gweithgaredd daeargrynfeydd yn ardal Hekla yn y 48 awr ddiwethaf.
text_en: The Icelandic Meteorological Office also reported no earthquake activity in the Hekla area in the past 48 hours.

text: Adroddwyd am gymylau tywyll nad oeddent yn gysylltiedig ag unrhyw weithgarwch folcanig ar waelod y mynydd.
text_en: Dark clouds unrelated to any volcanic activity were reported at the base of the mountain.

text_en: The clouds presented the potential for confusion as to whether an actual eruption had taken place.

text_en: The Luno had 120–160 cubic metres of fuel aboard when it broke down and high winds and waves pushed it into the breakwater.

text_en: Helicopters rescued the twelve crewmembers and the only injury was a broken nose.

text_en: The 100-metre ship was en route to pick up its usual fertiliser cargo and initially officials feared the vessel could spill a load.

text_en: The proposed amendment already passed both houses in 2011.

text_en: A change was made this legislative session when the second sentence was deleted first by the House of Representatives and then was passed in a similar form by the Senate Monday.

text_en: The failure of the second sentence, which proposes to ban same-sex civil unions, could possibly open the door for civil unions in the future.

text_en: Following the process, HJR-3 will be reviewed again by the next elected legislature in either 2015 or 2016 to remain in process.

text_en: As well as a former Olympic and World champion, Saito was the All Japan Judo Federation training committee chairman at the time of his death.

text_en: At least 100 people had attended the party, in order to celebrate the first anniversary of a couple whose wedding was held last year.

text_en: A formal anniversary event was scheduled for a later date, officials said.

text_en: The couple had married in Texas one year ago and came to Buffalo to celebrate with friends and relatives.

text_en: The 30-year-old husband, who was born in Buffalo, was one of the four killed in the shooting, but his wife was not hurt.

text_en: Karno is a well-known but controversial English tutor who taught under Modern Education and King's Glory who claimed to have 9,000 students at the peak of his career.

text_en: In his notes he used words which some parents considered coarse, and he reportedly used profanity in class.

text_en: Modern Education accused him of printing large advertisements on buses without authorisation and lying by saying that he was the chief English tutor.

text_en: He has also been accused previously of copyright infringement, but was not charged.

text_en: A former student said that he 'used slang in class, taught dating skills in notes, and was just like the students' friend.'

text_en: During the last three decades, despite officially remaining a communist state, China has developed a market economy.

text_en: The first economic reforms were made under the leadership of Deng Xiaoping.

text_en: Since then, China's economic size has grown by 90 times.

text: Am y tro cyntaf, y llynedd fe wnaeth Tsieina allforio mwy o geir na'r Almaen a threchu'r Unol Daleithiau fel y farchnad fwyaf ar gyfer y diwydiant hwn.
text_en: For the first time, last year China exported more cars than Germany and surpassed the United States as the biggest market for this industry.

text: Gallai Cynnyrch Domestig Gros Tsieina fod yn fwy na'r Unol Daleithiau o fewn dau ddegawd.
text_en: China's GDP could be larger than the United States within two decades.

text: Mae Storm Drofannol Danielle, y bedwaredd storm ag enw yn nhymor corwynt yr Iwerydd 2010, wedi ffurfio yn nwyrain Cefnfor yr Iwerydd.
text_en: Tropical Storm Danielle, fourth named storm of the 2010 Atlantic hurricane season, has formed in the eastern Atlantic Ocean.

text: Mae gan y storm, sydd wedi'i lleoli tua 3,000 milltir o Miami, Fflorida, uchafswm gwyntoedd parhaus o 40 mya (64 kph).
text_en: The storm, located approximately 3,000 miles from Miami, Florida, has maximum sustained winds of 40 mph (64 kph).

text: Mae gwyddonwyr yn y Ganolfan Gorwynt Genedlaethol yn rhag-weld y bydd Danielle yn cryfhau i gorwynt erbyn dydd Mercher.
text_en: Scientists at the National Hurricane Center predict that Danielle will strengthen to a hurricane by Wednesday.

text: Gan fod y storm yn bell o ddod i olwg tir, mae'n dal yn anodd asesu'r effaith bosibl ar yr Unol Daleithiau neu'r Caribî.
text_en: As the storm is far from landfall, it remains difficult to assess potential impact to the United States or Caribbean.

text: Mae Peter Lenz, rasiwr beic modur 13 mlwydd oed, wedi marw ar ôl bod mewn gwrthdrawiad ar Gwrs Rasio Beiciau Modur Indianapolis.
text_en: Peter Lenz, a 13-year-old motorcycle racer, has died after being involved in a crash at the Indianapolis Motor Speedway.

text: Tra ar dro cynhesu o gwmpas y trac, syrthiodd Lenz oddi ar ei feic, a chafodd ei daro wedyn gan ei gydrasiwr Xavier Zayat.
text_en: While on his warm-up lap, Lenz fell off his bike, and was then struck by fellow racer Xavier Zayat.

text_en: He was immediately attended to by the on-track medical staff and transported to a local hospital where he later died.

text: Ni chafodd Zayat ei anafu yn y ddamwain.
text_en: Zayat was unhurt in the accident.

text_en: Regarding the global financial situation, Zapatero continued by saying that "the financial system is a part of the economy, a crucial part.

text_en: We have a year-long financial crisis, which has had its most acute moment in the past two months, and I think now the financial markets are beginning to recover."

text_en: Last week, Naked News announced that it would dramatically increase its international language mandate to news reporting, with three new broadcasts.

text_en: Already reporting in English and Japanese, the global organization is launching Spanish, Italian, and Korean-language programs, for television, the web, and mobile devices.

text_en: "Luckily nothing happened to me, but I saw a macabre scene, as people tried to break windows in order to get out.

text_en: People were hitting the panes with chairs, but the windows were unbreakable.

text_en: One of the panes finally broke, and they started to get out by the window," said survivor Franciszek Kowal.

text_en: Stars give off light and heat because of the energy made when hydrogen atoms are merged (or fused) together to form heavier elements.

text: Mae gwyddonwyr yn gweithio i greu adweithydd a allai wneud ynni yn yr un modd.
text_en: Scientists are working to create a reactor that can make energy in the same way.

text: Mae hon, fodd bynnag, yn broblem anodd iawn i'w datrys a bydd yn cymryd llawer o flynyddoedd cyn i ni weld adweithyddion ymasiad defnyddiol yn cael eu codi.
text_en: This, however, is a very hard problem to solve and will take many years before we see useful fusion reactors built.

text: Mae'r nodwydd ddur yn arnofio ar ben y dŵr oherwydd tyndra arwyneb.
text_en: The steel needle floats on top of the water because of surface tension.

text: Mae tyndra arwyneb yn digwydd oherwydd bod moleciwlau dŵr ar arwyneb y dŵr wedi'u denu'n gryf at ei gilydd yn fwy nac y maen nhw at y moleciwlau aer uwch eu pennau.
text_en: Surface tension happens because the water molecules at the surface of the water are strongly attracted to each other more than they are to the air molecules above them.

text: Mae'r moleciwlau dŵr yn creu croen anweledig ar arwyneb y dŵr sy'n caniatáu i bethau fel y nodwydd arnofio ar ben y dŵr.
text_en: The water molecules make an invisible skin on the water’s surface that allows things like the needle to float on top of the water.

text: Mae gan y llafn ar esgid sglefrio fodern ymyl ddwbl a phant ceugrwm rhyngddynt. Mae'r ddwy ymyl yn caniatáu gwell gafael o'r iâ, hyd yn oed wedi'u gogwyddo.
text_en: The blade on a modern ice skate has a double edge with a concave hollow between them. The two edges allow for a better grasp of the ice, even when tilted.

text: Oherwydd bod gwaelod y llafn ychydig yn grwm, wrth i'r llafn wyro o un ochr i'r llall, mae'r ymyl sydd mewn cysylltiad â'r rhew hefyd yn crymu.
text_en: Because the bottom of the blade is slightly curved, as the blade tilts to one side or the other, the edge which is in contact with the ice also curves.

text: Mae hyn yn peri i'r sglefriwr droi. Os yw'r esgidiau sglefrio yn gogwyddo i'r dde, mae'r sglefriwr yn troi i'r dde, os yw'r sglefrau'n gogwyddo i'r chwith, mae'r sglefriwr yn troi i'r chwith.
text_en: This causes the skater to turn. If the skates tilt to the right, the skater turns right, if the skates tilt to the left, the skater turns left.

text: I ddychwelyd i'w lefel egni blaenorol, mae'n rhaid iddyn nhw gael gwared ar yr egni ychwanegol maen nhw wedi'i gael gan y golau.
text_en: To return to their previous energy level, they must get rid of the extra energy they got from the light.

text: Maen nhw'n gwneud hyn trwy fwrw allan gronyn bach o oleuni o'r enw "ffoton".
text_en: They do this by emitting a tiny particle of light called a "photon".

text: Mae gwyddonwyr yn galw'r broses hon yn "allyriad ymbelydredd wedi'i ysgogi" oherwydd bod yr atomau yn cael eu hysgogi gan y golau llachar, gan achosi allyrru ffoton o olau, ac mae golau yn fath o ymbelydredd.
text_en: Scientists call this process "stimulated emission of radiation" because the atoms are stimulated by the bright light, causing the emission of a photon of light, and light is a type of radiation.

text: Mae'r llun nesaf yn dangos yr atomau'n bwrw allan ffotonau. Wrth gwrs, mewn gwirionedd mae ffotonau yn llai o lawer na'r rheini yn y llun.
text_en: The next picture shows the atoms emitting photons. Of course, in reality photons are a lot smaller than those in the picture.

text: Mae ffotonau hyd yn oed yn llai na'r deunydd sy'n gwneud atomau!
text_en: Photons are even smaller than the stuff that makes up atoms!

text: Ar ôl cannoedd o oriau o weithredu bydd y ffilament yn y bwlb yn llosgi allan yn y pen draw ac ni fydd y bwlb golau yn gweithio mwyach.
text_en: After hundreds of hours of operation the filament in the bulb eventually burns out and the light bulb no longer works.

text: Mae angen newid y bwlb golau wedyn. Mae'n angenrheidiol i fod yn ofalus wrth newid y bwlb golau.
text_en: The light bulb then needs replacing. It is necessary to be careful in replacing the light bulb.

text: Yn gyntaf, mae angen diffodd y swits ar gyfer gosodiad y golau neu ddatgysylltu'r cebl.
text_en: First, the switch for the light fixture needs to be turned off or the cable disconnected.

text: Mae hyn oherwydd bod trydan sy'n llifo i mewn i'r soced lle mae rhan fetalaidd y bwlb yn eistedd yn gallu rhoi sioc drydanol ddifrifol i chi os byddwch chi'n cyffwrdd â'r tu mewn i'r soced neu waelod metal y bwlb tra'i fod yn dal yn rhannol yn y soced.
text_en: This is because electricity flowing into the socket where the metallic part of bulb sits can give you a severe electric shock if you touch the inside of the socket or the metal base of the bulb while it is still partly in the socket.

text: Prif organ system y cylchrediad yw'r galon, sy'n pwmpio'r gwaed.
text_en: The major organ of the circulatory system is the heart, which pumps the blood.

text: Mae gwaed yn mynd i ffwrdd o'r galon mewn tiwbiau o'r enw rhydwelïau ac yn dod yn ôl i'r galon mewn tiwbiau o'r enw gwythiennau. Enwau'r tiwbiau lleiaf yw capilarïau.
text_en: Blood goes away from the heart in tubes called arteries and comes back to the heart in tubes called veins. The smallest tubes are called capillaries.

text: Byddai dannedd trichorn wedi gallu chwalu nid dail yn unig ond hyd yn oed canghennau a gwreiddiau garw iawn.
text_en: A triceratops' teeth would have been able to crush not only leaves but even very tough branches and roots.

text: Mae rhai gwyddonwyr yn meddwl bod Triceratops yn bwyta sycadau, math o blanhigyn oedd yn gyffredin yn y Cyfnod Cretasaidd.
text_en: Some scientists think Triceratops ate cycads, which are a type of plant that was common in the Cretaceous.

text: Mae'r planhigion hyn yn edrych fel coed palmwydd bach gyda choron o ddail pigog, miniog.
text_en: These plants look like a small palm tree with a crown of sharp, spiky leaves.

text: Gallai Trichorn fod wedi defnyddio ei big cryf i dynnu'r dail i ffwrdd cyn bwyta'r boncyff.
text_en: A Triceratops could have used its strong beak to strip off the leaves before eating the trunk.

text: Mae gwyddonwyr eraill yn dadlau bod y planhigion hyn yn wenwynig iawn felly ei bod yn annhebygol bod unrhyw ddeinosor wedi eu bwyta, er bod y diogyn ac anifeiliaid eraill fel y parot (un o ddisgynyddion y deinosoriaid) yn gallu bwyta dail neu ffrwythau gwenwynig heddiw.
text_en: Other scientists argue that these plants are very poisonous so it is unlikely that any dinosaur ate them, even though today the sloth and other animals like the parrot (a descendant of the dinosaurs) can eat poisonous leaves or fruit.

text: Sut fyddai disgyrchiant Io yn tynnu arnaf fi? Pe byddech chi'n sefyll ar wyneb Io, byddech chi'n pwyso llai nag yr ydych chi ar y Ddaear.
text_en: How would Io's gravity pull on me? If you stood on the surface of Io, you would weigh less than you do on Earth.

text: Byddai person sy'n pwyso 200 pwys (90kg) ar y Ddaear yn pwyso tua 36 pwys (16kg) ar Io. Felly mae'r disgyrchiant, wrth gwrs, yn tynnu llai arnoch chi.
text_en: A person who weighs 200 pounds (90kg) on Earth would weigh about 36 pounds (16kg) on Io. So the gravity, of course, pulls less on you.

text: Nid oes gan yr Haul gramen fel y Ddaear y gallwch chi sefyll arni. Mae'r Haul cyfan wedi'i wneud o nwyon, tân a phlasma.
text_en: The Sun doesn't have a crust like the Earth that you can stand on. The whole Sun is made out of gases, fire, and plasma.

text: Mae'r nwy hwn yn mynd yn deneuach wrth i chi fynd ymhellach o ganol yr Haul.
text_en: The gas becomes thinner as you go farther from the center of the Sun.

text: Mae'r rhan allanol a welwn pan edrychwn ni ar yr Haul yn cael ei alw'n ffotosffer, sy'n golygu "pêl o olau".
text_en: The outer-part we see when we look at the Sun is called the photosphere, which means "ball of light".

text: Tua thair mil o flynyddoedd yn ddiweddarach, ym 1610, defnyddiodd y seryddwr Eidalaidd Galileo Galilei delesgôp i arsylwi bod gan Wener gyfnodau, yn union fel sydd gan y lleuad.
text_en: About three thousand years later, in 1610, Italian astronomer Galileo Galilei used a telescope to observe that Venus has phases, just as the moon does.

text: Mae cyfnodau'n digwydd oherwydd dim ond ochr Gwener (neu'r Lleuad) sy'n wynebu'r Haul sy'n cael ei oleuo. Roedd cyfnodau Gwener yn cefnogi damcaniaeth Copernicws bod y planedau'n mynd o amgylch yr haul.
text_en: Phases happen because only the side of Venus (or of the Moon) facing the Sun is lighted. The phases of Venus supported the theory of Copernicus that the planets go around the Sun.

text: Wedyn, ychydig flynyddoedd yn ddiweddarach yn 1639, sylwodd seryddwr o Loegr o'r enw Jeremiah Horrocks ar groesiad o Wener.
text_en: Then, a few years later in 1639, an English astronomer named Jeremiah Horrocks observed a transit of Venus.

text: Roedd Lloegr wedi profi cyfnod hir o heddwch ar ôl ailoresygniad Rhanbarth y Daniaid.
text_en: England had experienced a long period of peace after the reconquest of the Danelaw.

text: Fodd bynnag yn 991 roedd Ethelred yn wynebu fflyd Lychlynnaidd fwy nag unrhyw un ers Guthrum ganrif yn gynharach.
text_en: However in 991 Ethelred was faced with a Viking fleet larger than any since Guthrum's a century earlier.

text: Arweiniwyd y fflyd hon gan Olaf Trygvasson, Norwyad gydag uchelgais i adennill ei wlad o dra-arglwyddiaeth Denmarc.
text_en: This fleet was led by Olaf Trygvasson, a Norwegian with ambitions to reclaim his country from Danish domination.

text: Ar ôl rhwystrau milwrol cychwynnol, cytunodd Ethelred ar delerau ag Olaf, a ddychwelodd i Norwy i geisio ennill ei deyrnas â llwyddiant cymysg.
text_en: After initial military setbacks, Ethelred was able to agree to terms with Olaf, who returned to Norway to try to gain his kingdom with mixed success.

text: Hangeul yw'r unig wyddor a ddyfeisiwyd yn bwrpasol sydd mewn defnyddio dyddiol poblogaidd. Dyfeisiwyd yr wyddor ym 1444 yn ystod teyrnasiad y Brenin Sejong (1418-1450).
text_en: Hangeul is the only purposely invented alphabet in popular daily use. The alphabet was invented in 1444 during the reign of King Sejong (1418 – 1450).

text: Y Brenin Sejong oedd pedwerydd brenin y Llinach Joseon ac mae'n un o'r rhai uchaf ei barch.
text_en: King Sejong was the fourth king of the Joseon Dynasty and is one of the most highly regarded.

text: Enwodd e'r wyddor Hangeul yn Hunmin Jeongeum yn wreiddiol, sy'n golygu "y seiniau cywir ar gyfer hyfforddi'r bobl".
text_en: He originally named the Hangeul alphabet Hunmin Jeongeum, which means "the correct sounds for the instruction of the people".

text: Mae llawer o ddamcaniaethau ynghylch sut y daeth Sansgrit i fodolaeth. Mae un ohonynt yn ymwneud ag ymfudiad Aryaidd o'r gorllewin i'r India a ddaeth â'u hiaith gyda hwy.
text_en: There are many theories to how Sanskrit came into existence. One of them is about an Aryan migration from the west into India who brought their language with them.

text: Iaith hynafol yw Sansgrit sy'n debyg i'r iaith Ladin oedd yn cael ei siarad yn Ewrop.
text_en: Sanskrit is an ancient language and is comparable to the Latin language spoken in Europe.

text: Cafodd y llyfr cynharaf y gwyddom amdano yn y byd ei ysgrifennu mewn Sansgrit. Yn dilyn casgliad o Wpanisiadau, fe wnaeth Sansgrit ddiflannu oherwydd hierarchaeth.
text_en: The earliest known book in the world was written in Sanskrit. After the compilation of Upanishads, Sanskrit just faded due to hierarchy.

text: Mae Sansgrit yn iaith gyfoethog a chymhleth iawn, sydd wedi bod yn darddiad i nifer o ieithoedd Indiaidd modern, fel mae Lladin yn darddiad i ieithoedd Ewropeaidd fel Ffrangeg a Sbaeneg.
text_en: Sanskrit is a very complex and rich language, which has served to be the source for many modern Indian languages, just like Latin is the source for European languages like French and Spanish.

text: Gyda'r frwydr am Ffrainc wedi'i hennill, dechreuodd yr Almaen baratoi i oresgyn Ynys Prydain.
text_en: With the battle for France over, Germany began to get ready to invade the island of Britain.

text: Rhoddodd yr Almaen yr enw "Ymgyrch Sealion" i'r ymosodiad. Collwyd y mwyafrif o arfau a chyflenwadau Byddin Prydain pan ymadawodd â Dunkirk, felly roedd y fyddin yn rhesymol o wan.
text_en: Germany code-named the attack “Operation Sealion”. Most of the British Army's heavy weapons and supplies had been lost when it evacuated from Dunkirk, so the army was fairly weak.

text: Ond roedd y Llynges Frenhinol yn dal yn llawer cryfach na Llynges yr Almaen ("Kriegsmarine") a gallai fod wedi dinistrio unrhyw fflyd wedi'i hanfon i ymosod ar draws y Sianel.
text_en: But the Royal Navy was still much stronger than the German Navy (“Kriegsmarine”) and could have destroyed any invasion fleet sent across the English Channel.

text: Fodd bynnag, ychydig iawn o longau'r Llynges Frenhinol oedd wedi'u lleoli ger y llwybrau ymosod tebygol gan fod y llyngeswyr yn ofni y byddent yn cael eu suddo gan ymosodiad Almaenig o'r awyr.
text_en: However, very few Royal Navy ships were based near the likely invasion routes as the admirals were afraid they would be sunk by German air attack.

text: Beth am ddechrau gydag esboniad am gynlluniau'r Eidal? Yr Eidal yn bennaf oedd "brawd bach" yr Almaen a Siapan.
text_en: Let's start with an explanation about Italy's plans. Italy was mainly the "little brother" of Germany and Japan.

text: Roedd ganddo fyddin wannach a llynges wannach, er eu bod nhw newydd adeiladu pedair llong newydd yn union cyn dechrau'r rhyfel.
text_en: It had a weaker army and a weaker navy, although they had just built four new ships right before the beginning of the war.

text: Prif nodau'r Eidal oedd gwledydd Affricanaidd. Er mwyn cipio'r gwledydd hynny, byddai angen iddynt gael safle lansio, fel y gallai milwyr hwylio ar draws Môr y Canoldir ac ymosod ar Affrica.
text_en: Italy's main goals were African countries. To capture those countries, they would need to have a troop launching pad, so as troops could sail across the Mediterranean Sea and invade Africa.

text: Ar gyfer hynny, roedd yn rhaid iddyn nhw gael gwared ar safleoedd Prydeinig a llongau yn yr Aifft. Heblaw am y gweithredoedd hynny, nid oedd llongau'r Eidal i fod i wneud unrhyw beth arall.
text_en: For that, they had to get rid of British bases and ships in Egypt. Besides those actions, Italy's battleships were not supposed to do anything else.

text: Nawr am Siapan. Gwlad ynys oedd Siapan, yn union fel Prydain.
text_en: Now for Japan. Japan was an island country, just like Britain.

text: Llongau wedi'u cynllunio i deithio o dan ddŵr, ac i aros yno am gyfnod estynedig, yw llongau tanfor.
text_en: Submarines are ships designed to travel underwater, and remain there for an extended amount of time.

text: Defnyddiwyd llongau tanfor yn y Rhyfel Byd Cyntaf a'r Ail Ryfel Byd. Bryd hynny roedden nhw'n araf iawn ac roedd eu hystod saethu yn gyfyngedig iawn.
text_en: Submarines were used in World War I and World War II. Back then they were very slow and had a very limited shooting range.

text: Ar ddechrau'r rhyfel roedden nhw'n teithio yn bennaf ar ben y môr, ond wrth i radar ddechrau datblygu a dod yn fwy manwl gywir gorfodwyd y llongau tanfor i fynd o dan y dŵr er mwyn osgoi cael eu gweld.
text_en: In the beginning of the war they mostly travelled on top of the sea, but as radar began developing and becoming more accurate the submarines were forced to go under water to avoid being seen.

text: Cychod-U oedd enw llongau tanfor yr Almaen. Roedd yr Almaenwyr yn dda iawn am fordwyo a gweithredu eu llongau tanfor.
text_en: German submarines were called U-Boats. The Germans were very good at navigating and operating their submarines.

text: Oherwydd eu llwyddiant gyda llongau tanfor, ar ôl y rhyfel nid oedd modd ymddiried yn yr Almaenwyr i feddu ar lawer ohonyn nhw.
text_en: Because of their success with submarines, after the war Germans aren't trusted to have many of them.

text: Ie! Y Brenin Tutankhamun, y cyfeirir ato weithiau fel "Brenin Tut" neu'r "Bachgen Frenin", yw un o frenhinoedd hynafol mwyaf adnabyddus yr Aifft yn y cyfnod modern.
text_en: Yes! King Tutankhamun, sometimes referred to as "King Tut" or "The Boy King", is one of the most well known ancient Egyptian kings in modern times.

text: Yn ddiddorol, ni chafodd ei ystyried yn bwysig iawn yn yr hen oesoedd ac ni chafodd ei gofnodi ar restrau'r brenhinoedd mwyaf hynafol.
text_en: Interestingly, he was not considered to be very important in ancient times and was not recorded on most ancient king lists.

text: Fodd bynnag, fe wnaeth darganfyddiad ei feddrod ym 1922 ei wneud yn enwog. Er bod nifer o feddrodau'r dyfodol wedi cael eu lladrata, cafodd y beddrod hwn ei adael mwy neu lai yn ddigyffwrdd.
text_en: However, the discovery of his tomb in 1922 made him a celebrity. While many tombs of the past were robbed, this tomb was left virtually undisturbed.

text: Mae'r rhan fwyaf o'r eitemau wedi'u claddu gyda Tutankhamun wedi cael eu cadw'n dda, gan gynnwys miloedd o arteffactau wedi eu gwneud o fetalau gwerthfawr a cherrig prin.
text_en: Most of the items buried with Tutankhamun have been well preserved, including thousands of artefacts made from precious metals and rare stones.

text: Gwnaeth dyfeisio breichiau olwynion gerbydau rhyfela Asyriaidd yn ysgafnach, yn gyflymach, ac wedi'u paratoi'n well i fynd yn gynt na milwyr a cherbydau rhyfel eraill.
text_en: The invention of spoke wheels made Assyrian chariots lighter, faster, and better prepared to outrun soldiers and other chariots.

text: Roedd saethau o'u croesfwâu angheuol yn gallu treiddio arfwisg milwyr y gelyn. Tua 1000 C.C., cyflwynodd yr Asyriaid y marchfilwyr cyntaf.
text_en: Arrows from their deadly crossbows could penetrate the armor of rival soldiers. About 1000 B.C., the Assyrians introduced the first cavalry.

text: Byddin sy'n ymladd ar gefn ceffyl yw marchoglu. Nid oedd y cyfrwy wedi'i ddyfeisio eto, felly roedd marchoglu Asyriad yn ymladd ar gefnau digyfrwy eu ceffylau.
text_en: A cavalry is an army that fights on horseback. The saddle had not yet been invented, so the Assyrian cavalry fought on the bare backs of their horses.

text: Rydyn ni'n gwybod am nifer o wleidyddion, gwyddonwyr, ac artistiaid Groegaidd. O bosibl mai'r person mwyaf adnabyddus o'r diwylliant hwn yw Homer, y bardd dall chwedlonol, a gyfansoddodd ddau gampwaith o lenyddiaeth Roegaidd: y cerddi Iliad ac Odyssey.
text_en: We know many Greek politicians, scientists, and artists. Possibly the most known person of this culture is Homer, the legendary blind poet, who composed two masterpieces of Greek literature: the poems Iliad and Odyssey.

text: Mae Sophocles ac Aristophanes yn dal i fod yn ddramodwyr poblogaidd ac ystyrir bod eu dramâu ymhlith gweithiau llenyddol gorau'r byd.
text_en: Sophocles and Aristophanes are still popular playwrights and their plays are considered to be among the greatest works of world literature.

text: Groegwr enwog arall yw'r mathemategydd Pythagoras, sy'n adnabyddus yn bennaf am ei theorem enwog am berthnasoedd ochrau trionglau sgwâr-onglog.
text_en: Another famous Greek is a mathematician Pythagoras, mostly known for his famous theorem about relations of the sides of right triangles.

text: Mae amcangyfrifon amrywiol am faint o bobl sy'n siarad Hindi. Amcangyfrif ei bod hi rhwng yr ail a'r bedwaredd iaith fwyaf cyffredin yn y byd.
text_en: There are varying estimates for how many people speak Hindi. It is estimated to be between the second and fourth most commonly spoken language in the world.

text: Mae nifer y siaradwyr brodorol yn amrywio gan ddibynnu ar a yw tafodieithoedd sy'n perthyn yn agos iawn yn cael eu cyfrif ai peidio.
text_en: The number of native speakers varies depending on whether or not very closely related dialects are counted.

text: Mae'r amcangyfrifon yn amrywio o 340 miliwn i 500 miliwn o siaradwyr, ac mae cymaint ag 800 miliwn yn deall yr iaith.
text_en: Estimates range from 340 million to 500 million speakers, and as many as 800 million people can understand the language.

text: Mae Hindi ac Wrdw yn debyg mewn geirfa ond yn wahanol wedi'u hysgrifennu; mewn sgyrsiau bob dydd, mae siaradwyr y ddwy iaith yn gallu deall ei gilydd fel arfer.
text_en: Hindi and Urdu are similar in vocabulary but different in script; in everyday conversations, speakers of both languages can usually understand each other.

text: Tua'r 15fed ganrif, roedd gogledd Estonia dan ddylanwad diwylliannol yr Almaen yn fawr.
text_en: Around the 15th century, northern Estonia was under great cultural influence of Germany.

text: Roedd eisiau dod â Duw'n agosach at y bobl frodorol ar rai mynachod Almaeneg, felly fe ddyfeision nhw iaith lythrennol Estonia.
text_en: Some German monks wanted to bring God closer to the native people, so they invented the Estonian literal language.

text: Roedd yn seiliedig ar yr wyddor Almaenig ac un llythyren "Õ/õ" ychwanegol.
text_en: It was based on the German alphabet and one character "Õ/õ" was added.

text: Wrth i amser fynd heibio, cyfunodd llawer o eiriau a gafodd eu benthyg o'r Almaeneg. Dyma oedd dechrau goleuedigaeth.
text_en: As time passed, many words that were borrowed from German coalesced. This was the beginning of enlightenment.

text: Yn draddodiadol, byddai'r etifedd i'r goron yn mynd yn syth i mewn i'r lluoedd arfog ar ôl gorffen yn yr ysgol.
text_en: Traditionally, the heir to the throne would go straight into the military after finishing school.

text: Fodd bynnag, aeth Charles i'r brifysgol yng Ngholeg y Drindod, Caergrawnt lle astudiodd Anthropoleg ac Archaeoleg, ac yn ddiweddarach Hanes, gan ennill 2:2 (gradd ail ddosbarth is).
text_en: However, Charles went to university at Trinity College, Cambridge where he studied Anthropology and Archaeology, and later History, earning a 2:2 (a lower second class degree).

text: Charles oedd aelod cyntaf Teulu Brenhinol Prydain i ennill gradd.
text_en: Charles was the first member of the British Royal Family to be awarded a degree.

text: Mae Twrci Ewropeaidd (dwyrain Thrace neu Rumelia yng Ngorynys y Balcanau) yn cynnwys 3% o'r wlad.
text_en: European Turkey (eastern Thrace or Rumelia in the Balkan peninsula) includes 3% of the country.

text: Mae tiriogaeth Twrci yn fwy na 1,600 cilomedr (1,000 o filltiroedd) o hyd ac 800 cilomedr (500 milltir) o led, gyda siâp hirsgwar bras.
text_en: The territory of Turkey is more than 1,600 kilometres (1,000 mi) long and 800 km (500 mi) wide, with a roughly rectangular shape.

text: Mae arwynebedd Twrci, gan gynnwys llynnoedd, yn meddiannu 783,562 cilomedr sgwâr (300,948 milltir sgwâr), gyda 755,688 cilomedr sgwâr (291,773 milltir sgwâr) ohonynt yn ne-orllewin Asia a 23,764 cilomedr sgwar (9,174 Milltir sgwar) yn Ewrop.
text_en: Turkey's area, including lakes, occupies 783,562 square kilometres (300,948 sq mi), of which 755,688 square kilometres (291,773 sq mi) are in south west Asia and 23,764 square kilometres (9,174 sq mi) in Europe.

text: Mae arwynebedd Twrci yn ei gwneud yn 37fed gwlad mwya'r byd, ac mae hi tua maint Ffrainc Fetropolitan a'r Deyrnas Unedig gyda'i gilydd.
text_en: Turkey's area makes it the world's 37th-largest country, and is about the size of Metropolitan France and the United Kingdom combined.

text: Mae Twrci wedi'i amgylchynu gan foroedd ar dair ochr: Môr Aegea i'r gorllewin, y Môr Du i'r gogledd a Môr y Canoldir i'r de.
text_en: Turkey is encircled by seas on three sides: the Aegean Sea to the west, the Black Sea to the north and the Mediterranean Sea to the south.

text: Mae gan Lwcsembwrg hanes hir ond mae ei annibyniaeth yn dyddio o 1839.
text_en: Luxembourg has a long history but its independence dates from 1839.

text: Roedd rhannau o'r Wlad Belg bresennol yn rhan o Lwcsembwrg yn y gorffennol ond daethant yn rhan o Wlad Belg ar ôl Chwyldro Belgaidd yr 1830au.
text_en: Present-day parts of Belgium were part of Luxembourg in the past but became Belgian after the 1830s Belgian Revolution.

text: Mae Lwcsembwrg wedi ceisio aros yn wlad niwtral bob amser ond cafodd ei meddiannu gan yr Almaen yn y Rhyfel Byd Cyntaf yn ogystal â'r Ail Ryfel Byd.
text_en: Luxembourg has always tried to remain a neutral country but it was occupied in both World War I and World War II by Germany.

text: Yn 1957, daeth Lwcsembwrg yn aelod sefydlol o'r sefydliad sy'n cael ei adnabod heddiw fel yr Undeb Ewropeaidd.
text_en: In 1957 Luxembourg became a founding member of the organization which is today known as the European Union.

text: Caer adfeiliedig a mynachdy Bwdhaidd yn rhan uchaf Ardal Paro (ym Mhentref Phondey) yw'r Drukgyal Dzong.
text_en: The Drukgyal Dzong is a ruined fortress and Buddhist monastery in the upper part of the Paro District (in Phondey Village).

text: Dywedir i Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel greu'r gaer er cof am ei fuddugoliaeth yn erbyn lluoedd Tibet a Mongolia yn 1649.
text_en: It is said that in 1649, Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyel created the fortress to commemorate his victory against the Tibetan-Mongol forces.

text: Yn 1951, fe wnaeth tân achosi i ddim ond rhai o greiriau'r Dukgyal Dzong aros, fel y ddelwedd o Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.
text_en: In 1951, a fire caused for only some of the relics of the Drukgyal Dzong to remain, such as the image of Zhabdrung Ngawang Namgyal.

text: Yn dilyn y tân, cafodd yr amddiffynfa ei chadw a'i hamddiffyn, gan barhau i fod yn un o atyniadau mwyaf aruthrol Bhwtan.
text_en: After the fire, the fortress was preserved and protected, remaining to be one of Bhutan's most sensational attractions.

text: Yn ystod y ddeunawfed ganrif cafodd Cambodia ei hun wedi'i gwasgu rhwng dau gymydog pwerus, Gwlad Thai a Fietnam.
text_en: During the 18th century Cambodia found itself squeezed between two powerful neighbors, Thailand and Vietnam.

text: Ymosododd y Taiaid ar Gambodia sawl gwaith yn y 18fed ganrif ac yn 1772 gwnaethon nhw ddinistrio Phnom Phen.
text_en: The Thais invaded Cambodia several times in the 18th century and in 1772 they destroyed Phnom Phen.

text: Ym mlynyddoedd olaf y ddeunawfed ganrif, ymosododd y Fietnamiaid hefyd ar Gambodia.
text_en: In the last years of the 18th century the Vietnamese also invaded Cambodia.

text: Mae deunaw y cant o Fenesweliaid yn ddi-waith, ac mae'r rhan fwyaf o'r rhai sy'n gyflogedig yn gweithio yn yr economi anffurfiol.
text_en: Eighteen percent of Venezuelans are unemployed, and most of those who are employed work in the informal economy.

text: Mae dau draean o bobl Feneswela sy'n gweithio yn gwneud hynny yn y sector gwasanaeth, mae bron i chwarter yn gweithio mewn diwydiant ac un o bob pump mewn amaethyddiaeth.
text_en: Two thirds of Venezuelans who work do so in the service sector, nearly a quarter work in industry and a fifth work in agriculture.

text: Mae olew yn ddiwydiant pwysig i Fenesweliaid, ac mae'r wlad yn allforiwr net, er mai dim ond un y cant sy'n gweithio yn y diwydiant olew.
text_en: An important industry for Venezuelans is oil, where the country is a net exporter, even though only one percent work in the oil industry.

text: Yn gynnar yn annibyniaeth y genedl, helpodd arbenigedd Gerddi Botaneg Singapôr drawsnewid yr ynys i Ddinas Gerddi drofannol.
text_en: Early in the nation's independence, Singapore Botanic Gardens' expertise helped to transform the island into a tropical Garden City.

text: Yn 1981, cafodd Vanda Miss Joaquim, hybrid o degeirian, ei ddewis fel blodyn cenedlaethol y genedl.
text_en: In 1981, Vanda Miss Joaquim, an orchid hybrid, was chosen as the nation's national flower.

text: Bob blwyddyn tua mis Hydref mae bron i 1.5 miliwn o lysysorion yn teithio tuag at y gwastadeddau deheuol, gan groesi Afon Mara, o'r bryniau gogleddol am y glaw.
text_en: Every year around October nearly 1.5 million herbivores travel towards the southern plains, crossing the Mara River, from the northern hills for the rains.

text: Ac yna yn ôl i'r gogledd trwy'r gorllewin, gan groesi'r afon Mara unwaith eto, ar ôl y glaw tua mis Ebrill.
text_en: And then back to the north through the west, once again crossing the Mara river, after the rains in around April.

text: Mae rhanbarth y Serengeti yn cynnwys Parc Cenedlaethol y Serengeti, Ardal Gadwraeth Ngorongoro a Gwarchodfa Anifeiliaid Maswa yn Nhansanïa a Gwarchodfa Genedlaethol Maasai Mara yng Nghenia.
text_en: The Serengeti region contains the Serengeti National Park, the Ngorongoro Conservation Area and Maswa Game Reserve in Tanzania and the Maasai Mara National Reserve in Kenya.

text: Mae dysgu creu cyfryngau rhyngweithiol yn gofyn am sgiliau confensiynol a thraddodiadol, yn ogystal ag offer wedi'u meistroli mewn dosbarthiadau rhyngweithiol (creu bwrdd stori, golygu sain a fideo, adrodd straeon, ac ati)
text_en: Learning to create interactive media requires conventional and traditional skills, as well as tools mastered in interactive classes (storyboarding, audio and video editing, story telling, etc.)

text: Mae dylunio rhyngweithiol yn gofyn i chi ail-asesu eich rhagdybiaethau am gynhyrchu cyfryngau a dysgu i feddwl mewn ffyrdd aflinol.
text_en: Interactive design requires that you re-assess your assumptions about media production and learn to think in a non-linear ways.

text: Mae dyluniad rhyngweithiol yn mynnu bod cydrannau prosiect yn cysylltu â'i gilydd, ond hefyd yn gwneud synnwyr fel endid ar wahân.
text_en: Interactive design requires that components of a project connect to each other, but also make sense as a separate entity.

text: Anfantais lensys chwyddo yw bod cymhlethdod ffocal a'r nifer o elfennau lens sydd eu hangen yn fwy o lawer nac ar gyfer lensys safonol.
text_en: The disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the focal complexity and number of lens elements required to achieve a range of focal lengths is much greater than for prime lenses.

text: Mae hyn yn dod yn llai o broblem wrth i wneuthurwyr lensys gyflawni safonau uwch wrth gynhyrchu lensys.
text_en: This is becoming less of an issue as lens manufacturers achieve higher standards in lens production.

text: Mae hyn wedi caniatáu i lensys chwyddo gynhyrchu llunia o ansawdd tebyg i'r ansawdd a gyflawnir gan lensys â hyd ffocal sefydlog.
text_en: This has allowed zoom lenses to produce pictures of a quality comparable to that achieved by lenses with fixed focal length.

text: Anfantais arall lensys chwyddo yw bod agorfa uchaf (cyflymder) y lens fel arfer yn is.
text_en: Another disadvantage of zoom lenses is that the maximum aperture (the speed) of the lens is usually lower.

text: Mae hyn yn gwneud lensys chwyddo rhad yn anodd eu defnyddio mewn amodau goleuni isel heb fflach.
text_en: This makes inexpensive zoom lenses hard to use in low-light conditions without a flash.

text: Un o'r problemau mwyaf cyffredin wrth geisio trosi ffilm i fformat DVD yw'r tros-sgan.
text_en: One of the most common problems when trying to convert a movie to DVD format is the overscan.

text: Mae'r rhan fwyaf o setiau teledu yn cael eu gwneud i blesio'r cyhoedd.
text_en: Most televisions are made in a way to please the general public.

text: Am y rheswm hwnnw, roedd gan bopeth rydych chi'n ei weld ar y teledu eu hymylon wedi'u torri, brig, gwaelod ac ochrau.
text_en: For that reason, everything you see on the TV had the borders cut, top, bottom and sides.

text: Mae hyn yn cael ei wneud i wneud yn siwr bod y ddelwedd yn cwmpasu'r sgrin i gyd. Yr enw ar hynny yw dros-sgan.
text_en: This is made to ensure that the image covers the whole screen. That is called overscan.

text: Yn anffodus, pan fyddwch chi'n gwneud DVD, bydd ei ymylon fwy na thebyg yn cael eu torri hefyd, a phe byddai gan y fideo is-deitlau yn rhy agos at y gwaelod, fyddan nhw ddim yn cael eu dangos yn llawn.
text_en: Unfortunately, when you make a DVD, it's borders will most likely be cut too, and if the video had subtitles too close to the bottom, they won't be fully shown.

text: Mae'r castell canoloesol traddodiadol wedi ysbrydoli'r dychymyg ers amser maith, gan greu delweddau o ymwaniadau, gwleddoedd a marchogwraeth Arthuraidd.
text_en: The traditional medieval castle has long inspired the imagination, conjuring up images of jousts, banquets and Arthurian chivalry.

text: Hyd yn oed yn sefyll ymhlith adfeilion mil blwydd oed mae'n hawdd dwyn seiniau ac arogleuon brwydrau wedi hen fynd heibio i gof, i glywed clindarddach y carnau ar y cerrig crynion ac i arogli'r ofn yn codi o byllau'r ddaeargell bron.
text_en: Even standing amidst thousand year-old ruins it is easy to bring to mind the sounds and smells of battles long gone, to almost hear the clatter of hooves on the cobbles and to smell the fear rising from the dungeon pits.

text: Ond a yw'n dychymyg yn seiliedig ar realiti? Pam gafodd cestyll eu hadeiladu yn y lle cyntaf? Sut gawson nhw eu cynllunio a'u hadeiladu?
text_en: But is our imagination based on reality? Why were castles built in the first place? How were they designed and built?

text: Yn nodweddiadol am y cyfnod, mae Castell Kirby Muxloe yn fwy o dŷ caerog na chastell gwirioneddol.
text_en: Typical for the period, Kirby Muxloe Castle is more of a fortified house than a true castle.

text: Ni fyddai ei ffenestri gwydr mawr a'i waliau tenau wedi gallu gwrthsefyll ymosodiad penderfynol yn hir.
text_en: Its large glazed windows and thin walls would not have been able to resist a determined attack for long.

text: Yn y 1480au, pan ddechreuwyd ei hadeiladu gan yr Arglwydd Hastings, roedd y wlad yn gymharol heddychlon a dim ond yn erbyn criwiau bach o ysbeilwyr crwydrol roedd angen amddiffyn.
text_en: In the 1480s, when its construction was begun by Lord Hastings, the country was relatively peaceful and defense was only required against small bands of roving marauders.

text: Roedd cydbwysedd pŵer yn system lle roedd cenhedloedd Ewropeaidd yn ceisio cynnal sofraniaeth genedlaethol pob gwladwriaeth Ewropeaidd ynddi.
text_en: The balance of power was a system in which European nations sought to maintain the national sovereignty of all European states.

text: Y cysyniad oedd bod rhaid i holl genhedloedd Ewrop geisio atal un genedl rhag mynd yn bwerus, ac felly roedd lywodraethau cenedlaethol yn newid eu cynghreiriau'n aml er mwyn cynnal y cydbwysedd.
text_en: The concept was that all European nations had to seek to prevent one nation from becoming powerful, and thus national governments often changed their alliances in order to maintain the balance.

text: Rhyfel Olyniaeth Sbaen oedd y rhyfel gyntaf yr oedd cydbwysedd grym yn fater canolog iddi hi.
text_en: The War of Spanish Succession marked the first war whose central issue was the balance of power.

text: Roedd hyn yn nodi newid pwysig, gan na fyddai gan bwerau Ewropeaidd yr esgus o fod yn rhyfeloedd crefyddol. Felly, y Rhyfel Trideg Mlynedd fyddai'r rhyfel olaf i gael ei labelu'n rhyfel crefyddol.
text_en: This marked an important change, as European powers would no longer have the pretext of being religious wars. Thus, the Thirty Years' War would be the last war to be labeled a religious war.

text: Cafodd teml Artemis yn Effesus ei dinistrio ar Orffennaf 21, 356 BCE mewn gweithred o losgi bwriadol a gyflawnwyd gan Herostratus.
text_en: The temple of Artemis at Ephesus was destroyed on July 21, 356 BCE in an act of arson committed by Herostratus.

text: Yn ôl y stori, ei gymhelliant oedd enwogrwydd ar unrhyw gost. Cyhoeddodd yr Effesiaid, wedi gwylltio, na ddylid cofnodi enw Herostratus byth.
text_en: According to the story, his motivation was fame at any cost. The Ephesians, outraged, announced that Herostratus' name never be recorded.

text: Yn ddiweddarach, fe wnaeth yr hanesydd Groegaidd, Strabo, nodi'r enw, a dyna sut rydyn ni'n gwybod heddiw. Dinistriwyd y deml yr un noson ag y ganwyd Alecsander Fawr.
text_en: The Greek historian Strabo later noted the name, which is how we know today. The temple was destroyed on the same night that Alexander the Great was born.

text: Fe wnaeth Alecsander, fel brenin, gynnig talu i ailadeiladu'r deml, ond gwrthodwyd ei gynnig. Yn ddiweddarach, wedi i Alecsander farw, ailadeiladwyd y deml yn 323 BCE.
text_en: Alexander, as king, offered to pay to rebuild the temple, but his offer was denied. Later, after Alexander died, the temple was rebuilt in 323 BCE.

text: Dylech sicrhau bod eich llaw wedi ymlacio cymaint â phosibl tra'n taro'r holl nodau yn gywir - hefyd ceisiwch beidio â gwneud llawer o symudiadau di-angen gyda'ch bysedd.
text_en: Make sure your hand is as relaxed as possible while still hitting all the notes correctly - also try not to make much extraneous motion with your fingers.

text: Yn y ffordd hon, byddwch chi'n blino eich hun cyn lleied â phosibl. Cofiwch nad oes angen taro'r allweddi â llawer o rym ar gyfer sain ychwanegol megis ar y piano.
text_en: This way, you will tire yourself out as little as possible. Remember there's no need to hit the keys with a lot of force for extra volume like on the piano.

text: Ar yr acordion, i gael sain ychwanegol, rydych chi'n defnyddio'r meginau â mwy o bwysau neu gyflymder.
text_en: On the accordion, to get extra volume, you use the bellows with more pressure or speed.

text: Cyfriniaeth yw mynd ar drywydd cymundeb â, uniaethu â, neu ymwybyddiaeth ymwybodol o realiti eithaf, diwinyddiaeth, gwirionedd ysbrydol, neu Dduw.
text_en: Mysticism is the pursuit of communion with, identity with, or conscious awareness of an ultimate reality, divinity, spiritual truth, or God.

text: Mae'r credadun yn ceisio profiad uniongyrchol, greddf, neu ddirnadaeth o realaeth ddwyfol/y duwdod neu dduwdodau.
text_en: The believer seeks a direct experience, intuition, or insight into divine reality/the deity or dieties.

text: Mae dilynwyr yn dilyn ffyrdd penodol o fyw, neu arferion sydd wedi'u bwriadu i feithrin y profiadau hynny.
text_en: Followers pursue certain ways of living, or practices that are intended to nurture those experiences.

text: Gellir gwahaniaethu cyfriniaeth â mathau eraill o gred ac addoliad crefyddol trwy ei bwyslais ar y profiad personol uniongyrchol o gyflwr unigryw o ymwybyddiaeth, yn enwedig y rhai hynny o gymeriad heddychlon, craff, braf, neu ecstatig hyd yn oed.
text_en: Mysticism can be distinguished from other forms of religious belief and worship by its emphasis on the direct personal experience of a unique state of consciousness, particularly those of a peaceful, insightful, blissful, or even ecstatic character.

text: Crefydd o is-gyfandir India ydi Siciaeth. Tarddodd yn rhanbarth Punjab yn ystod y 15fed ganrif o hollt sectyddol o fewn y traddodiad Hindŵaidd.
text_en: Sikhism is a religion from the Indian sub-continent. It originated in the Punjab region during the 15th century from a sectarian split within the Hindu tradition.

text: Mae Sikhiaid yn ystyried eu ffydd yn grefydd ar wahân i Hindŵaeth er eu bod yn cydnabod ei wreiddiau a thraddodiadau Hindŵaidd.
text_en: Sikhs consider their faith to be a separate religion from Hinduism though they acknowledge its Hindu roots and traditions.

text: Mae Siciaid yn galw eu crefydd yn Gurmat, sef "ffordd y gwrw" mewn Pwnjabeg. Mae'r gwrw yn agwedd hanfodol ar yr holl grefyddau Indiaidd ond mewn Siciaeth mae wedi dod mor bwysig nes ei fod yn ffurfio craidd credoau Sicaidd.
text_en: Sikhs call their religion Gurmat, which is Punjabi for "way of the guru". The guru is a fundamental aspect of all Indian religions but in Sikhism has taken on an importance that forms the core of Sikh beliefs.

text: Sefydlwyd y grefydd yn y 15fed ganrif gan Gwrw Nanak (1469-1539). Dilynodd naw gwrw arall yn olynol.
text_en: The religion was founded in the 15th century by Guru Nanak (1469–1539). There followed in succession a further nine gurus.

text: Fodd bynnag, ym mis Mehefin 1956, rhoddwyd addewidion Krushchev ar brawf pan drodd terfysgoedd yng Ngwlad Pwyl, lle'r oedd gweithwyr yn protestio yn erbyn prinder bwyd a thoriadau cyflog, yn brotest gyffredinol yn erbyn Comiwnyddiaeth.
text_en: However, in June 1956, Krushchev's promises were put to the test when riots in Poland, where workers were protesting against food shortages and wage cuts, turned into a general protest against Communism.

text: Er yn y diwedd, anfonodd Krushchev danciau i mewn i adfer trefn, ildiodd i rai o'r gofynion economaidd a chytunodd i benodi'r Wladyslaw Gomulka poblogaidd yn brif weinidog newydd.
text_en: Although in the end, Krushchev sent in tanks to restore order, he did give way to some economic demands and agreed to appoint the popular Wladyslaw Gomulka as the new prime minister.

text: Roedd Gwareiddiad Dyffryn Indus yn wareiddiad Oes Efydd yng ngogledd-orllewin is-gyfandir India sy'n cwmpasu'r rhan fwyaf o Bacistan heddiw a rhai rhanbarthau yng ngogledd-orllewin India a gogledd-ddwyrain Affganistan.
text_en: The Indus Valley Civilization was a Bronze Age civilisation in the northwest Indian subcontinent encompassing most of modern-day Pakistan and some regions in northwest India and northeast Afghanistan.

text: Ffynnodd y gwareiddiad ym masnau'r Afon Indus, o ble mae'n cael ei enw.
text_en: The civilisation flourished in the basins of the Indus River wherefore it derives its name.

text: Er bod rhai ysgolheigion yn dyfalu gan fod y gwareiddiad hefyd wedi bodoli ym masnau'r Afon Sarasvati sydd wedi sychu yn awr, dylai gael ei alw'n Wareiddiad Indus-Sarasvati ar ôl Harappa, y cyntaf o'i safleoedd i gael ei gloddio yn y 1920au.
text_en: Although some scholars speculate that since the civilisation also existed in the basins of the now dried up Sarasvati River, it should be aptly called the Indus-Sarasvati Civilization, while some call it the Harappan Civilization after Harappa, the first of its sites to be excavated in the 1920s.

text: Fe wnaeth natur filwrol yr ymerodraeth Rufeinig helpu i ffurfio datblygiadau meddygol.
text_en: The militaristic nature of the Roman empire aided in the development of medical advances.

text: Dechreuodd feddygon gael eu recriwtio gan yr Ymerawdwr Awgwstws a hyd yn oed ffurfio'r Corfflu Meddygol Rhufeinig cyntaf i'w ddefnyddio yn sgìl brwydrau.
text_en: Doctors began to be recruited by Emperor Augustus and even formed the first Roman Medical Corps for use in the aftermath of battles.

text: Roedd llawfeddygon yn gwybod am sawl tawelydd gan gynnwys morffinau o echdyniadau o hadau pabi a sgopolamin o hadau herban.
text_en: Surgeons had knowledge of various sedatives including morphine from extracts of poppy seeds and scopolamine from herbane seeds.

text: Daethant yn hyddysg iawn mewn torri aelodau i arbed cleifion rhag madredd yn ogystal â rhwymynnau tynhau a chlampiau i'r rhydwelïau i atal llif gwaed.
text_en: They became proficient at amputation to save patients from gangrene as well as tourniquets and arterial clamps to stem blood flow.

text: Dros lawer o ganrifoedd, arweiniodd yr Ymerodraeth Rufeinig at enillion mawr ym maes meddygaeth a ffurfio llawer o'r wybodaeth sydd gennym heddiw.
text_en: Over multiple centuries, the Roman empire led to great gains in the field of medicine and formed much of the knowledge we know today.

text: Mae origami Pureland yn origami â'r cyfyngiad mai un plyg yn unig sy'n gallu cael ei wneud ar y tro, nid yw plygiadau mwy cymhleth fel plygiadau gwrthol yn cael eu caniatáu, ac mae gan bob plyg leoliadau syml.
text_en: Pureland origami is origami with the restriction that only one fold may be done at a time, more complex folds like reverse folds are not allowed, and all folds have straightforward locations.

text: Cafodd ei ddatblygu gan John Smith yn yr 1970au i helpu plygwyr dibrofiad neu'r rheiny â sgiliau symud cyfyngedig.
text_en: It was developed by John Smith in the 1970s to help inexperienced folders or those with limited motor skills.

text: Mae plant yn datblygu ymwybyddiaeth o hil a stereoteipiau hiliol yn eithaf ifanc ac mae'r stereoteipiau hyn yn cael effaith ar ymddygiad.
text_en: Children develop an awareness of race and racial stereotypes quite young and these racial stereotypes affect behavior.

text: Er enghraifft, mae plant sy'n uniaethu â lleiafrif hiliol sy'n cael ei stereoteipio fel un sydd ddim yn gwneud yn dda yn yr ysgol yn tueddu i beidio â gwneud yn dda yn yr ysgol unwaith y dysgant am y stereoteip sy'n gysylltiedig â'u hil.
text_en: For instance, children who identify with a racial minority that is stereotyped as not doing well in school tend to not do well in school once they learn about the stereotype associated with their race.

text: MySpace yw'r drydedd wefan fwyaf poblogaidd sy'n cael ei defnyddio yn yr UD ac mae 54 miliwn o broffiliau ganddi ar hyn o bryd.
text_en: MySpace is the third most popular website used in the United States and has 54 million profiles currently.

text: Mae'r gwefannau hyn wedi cael llawer o sylw, yn enwedig yn ym myd addysg.
text_en: These websites have gotten a lot of attention, especially in the education setting.

text: Mae agweddau positif i'r gwefannau hyn, sy'n cynnwys gallu gosod tudalen dosbarth yn hawdd a allai gynnwys blogiau, fideos, lluniau, a nodweddion eraill.
text_en: There are positive aspects to these websites, which include, being able to easily setup a class page which can include blogs, videos, photos, and other features.

text: Gellir cyrchu'r dudalen hon yn hawdd trwy ddarparu un cyfeiriad gwe yn unig, sy'n ei gwneud hi'n haws i gofio a theipio i mewn i fyfyrwyr a allai gael trafferth i ddefnyddio'r bysellfwrdd neu â sillafu.
text_en: This page can easily be accessed by providing just one web address, which makes it easy to remember and easy to type in for students who may have trouble using the keyboard or with spelling.

text: Gellir ei addasu i'w wneud yn haws i'w ddarllen a hefyd â chymaint neu gyn lleied o liw ag y dymunir.
text_en: It can be customized to make it easy to read and also with as much or little color as desired.

text: Mae Anhwylder Diffyg Canolbwyntio "yn syndrom niwrolegol y mae ei dri symptom diffiniol clasurol yn cynnwys byrbwylltra, tynnu sylw, a gorfywiogrwydd neu egni gormodol".
text_en: Attention Deficit Disorder "is a neurological syndrome whose classic defining triad of symptoms including impulsivity, distractibility, and hyperactivity or excess energy".

text: Nid yw'n anabledd dysgu, mae'n anhwylder dysgu; mae'n "effeithio ar 3 i 5 y cant o blant, efallai cymaint â 2 filiwn o blant America".
text_en: It is not a learning disability, it is a learning disorder; it "affects 3 to 5 percent of all children, perhaps as many as 2 million American children".

text: Mae plant ag ADD yn ei chael hi'n anodd canolbwyntio ar bethau fel gwaith ysgol, ond gallant ganolbwyntio ar bethau y maen nhw'n mwynhau eu gwneud fel chwarae gemau neu wylio eu hoff gartwnau neu ysgrifennu brawddegau heb atalnodi.
text_en: Children with ADD have a hard time focusing on things like school work, but they can concentrate on things they enjoy doing like playing games or watching their favorite cartoons or writing sentences without punctuation.

text: Mae'r plant yn dueddol o fynd i lawer o drwbl, oherwydd maen nhw'n "ymwneud mewn ymddygiadau peryglus, yn cwffio, ac yn herio awdurdod" er mwyn ysgogi eu hymennydd, gan na ellir ysgogi eu hymennydd trwy ddulliau arferol.
text_en: These children tend to get into a lot of trouble, because they "engage in risky behaviors, get into fights, and challenge authority" in order to stimulate their brain, since their brain can not be stimulated by normal methods.

text: Mae ADD yn effeithio ar berthnasoedd gyda chyfoedion eraill oherwydd nad yw plant eraill yn gallu deall pam eu bod yn ymddwyn fel maen nhw neu pam maen nhw'n sillafu'r ffordd maen nhw neu fod eu lefel aeddfedrwydd yn wahanol.
text_en: ADD affects relationships with other peers because other children can not understand why they act the way that they do or why they spell they way they do or that their maturity level is different.

text: Wrth i'r gallu i gyrchu gwybodaeth ac i ddysgu newid yn y fath ffordd a soniwyd amdano uchod, newidiodd y gyfradd sylfaenol ar gyfer cyrchu gwybodaeth hefyd.
text_en: As the ability to obtain knowledge and to learn changed in such a way as mentioned above the base rate at which knowledge was obtained changed.

text: Roedd yr ymagwedd at gael gwybodaeth yn wahanol. Nid oedd pwysau mwyach ar gof yr unigolyn, ond daeth y gallu i gofio testun yn fwy o ganolbwynt.
text_en: The approach to obtaining information was different. No longer did pressure reside within individual recall, but the ability to recall text became more of a focus.

text: Yn y bôn, gwnaeth y Dadeni newid arwyddocaol yn yr ymagwedd at ddysgu a lledaenu gwybodaeth.
text_en: In essence, the Renaissance made a significant change in the approach to learning and the dissemination of knowledge.

text: Yn wahanol i brimatiaid eraill, nid yw hominidiaid bellach yn defnyddio'u dwylo i ymsymud neu gynnal pwysau neu swingio trwy'r coed.
text_en: Unlike other primates, hominids no longer use their hands in locomotion or bearing weight or swinging through the trees.

text: Mae llaw a throed y tsimpansî yn debyg o ran maint a hyd, gan adlewyrchu defnydd y llaw ar gyfer dwyn pwysau wrth gerdded ar figyrnau.
text_en: The chimpanzee's hand and foot are similar in size and length, reflecting the hand's use for bearing weight in knuckle walking.

text: Mae'r llaw ddynol yn fyrrach na'r droed, â ffalangau sythach.
text_en: The human hand is shorter than the foot, with straighter phalanges.

text: Mae esgyrn llaw ffosil dwy i dair miliwn blwydd oed yn datgelu'r newid hwn yn arbenigedd y llaw o ymsymudiad i drin yn ddeheuig.
text_en: Fossil hand bones two million to three million years old reveal this shift in specialization of the hand from locomotion to manipulation.

text: Mae rhai pobl yn credu bod profi llawer o freuddwydion eglur wedi'u hachosi'n artiffisial yn gallu bod yn flinderus iawn.
text_en: Some people believe that experiencing many artificially induced lucid dreams often enough can be very exhausting.

text: Y prif reswm dros y ffenomen hon yw canlyniad y breuddwydion eglur sy'n ehangu'r cyfnod amser rhwng cyflyrau REM.
text_en: The main reason for this phenomenon is the result of the lucid dreams expanding the length of time between REM states.

text: Gyda llai o REMs bob nos, mae'r cyflwr hwn y profwch chi gwsg gwirioneddol ynddo a'ch corff yn adfer yn dod yn ddigon anaml i ddod yn broblem.
text_en: With fewer REMs per night, this state in which you experience actual sleep and your body recovers becomes infrequent enough to become a problem.

text: Mae hyn yr un mor llethol â phe byddech chi'n deffro pob ugain neu drideg munud a gwylio'r teledu.
text_en: This is just as exhausting as if you were to wake up every twenty or thirty minutes and watch TV.

text: Mae'r effaith yn dibynnu ar ba mor aml mae eich ymennydd yn ceisio breuddwydio'n eglur bob nos.
text_en: The effect is dependent on how often your brain attempts to lucidly dream per night.

text: Nid aeth pethau'n dda i'r Eidalwyr yng Ngogledd Affrica bron o'r cychwyn. O fewn wythnos o'r Eidal yn datgan rhyfel ar Fehefin 10, 1940, roedd 11eg Hussars Prydain wedi cipio Fort Capuzzo yn Libya.
text_en: Things did not go well for the Italians in North Africa almost from the start. Within a week of Italy's declaration of war on June 10, 1940, the British 11th Hussars had seized Fort Capuzzo in Libya.

text: Mewn cudd-ymosodiad i'r dwyrain o Bardia, cipiodd y Prydeinwyr brif Beiriannydd Degfed Fyddin yr Eidal, y Cadfridog Lastucci.
text_en: In an ambush east of Bardia, the British captured the Italian Tenth Army's Engineer-in-Chief, General Lastucci.

text: Ar Fehefin 28, cafodd Marshal Italo Balbo, Llywodraethwr Cyffredinol Libia ac etifedd amlwg Mussolini, ei ladd gan saethu cyfeillgar wrth lanio yn Tobruk.
text_en: On June 28, Marshal Italo Balbo, the Governor-General of Libya and apparent heir to Mussolini, was killed by friendly fire while landing in Tobruk.

text: Mae'r gamp fodern o ffensio yn cael ei chwarae ar sawl lefel, o fyfyrwyr yn dysgu mewn prifysgol i gystadlu'n broffesiynol ac yn y Gemau Olympaidd.
text_en: The modern sport of fencing is played at many levels, from students learning at a university to professional and Olympic competition.

text: Mae'r gamp yn cael ei chwarae mewn fformat deuol, un cleddyfwr yn gornestu ag un arall.
text_en: The sport is primarily played in a duel format, one fencer dueling another.

text: Mae golff yn gêm lle mae chwaraewyr yn defnyddio ffyn i daro peli i mewn i dyllau.
text_en: Golf is a game in which players use clubs to hit balls into holes.

text: Mae deunaw twll yn cael eu chwarae yn ystod rownd reolaidd, gyda chwaraewyr fel arfer yn cychwyn ar y twll cyntaf ac yn gorffen ar y deunawfed.
text_en: Eighteen holes are played during a regular round, with players usually starting on the first hole on the course and finishing on the eighteenth.

text: Mae'r chwaraewr sy'n defnyddio'r nifer leiaf o ergydion, neu chwifiadau o'r ffyn, i gwblhau'r cwrs yn ennill.
text_en: The player who takes the fewest strokes, or swings of the club, to complete the course wins.

text: Mae'r gêm yn cael ei chwarae ar laswellt, ac mae'r glaswellt o amgylch y twll yn cael ei dorri'n fyrrach ac yn cael ei alw'n laslawr.
text_en: The game is played on grass, and the grass around the hole is mown shorter and called the green.

text: Efallai mai'r math mwyaf cyffredin o dwristiaeth yw beth mae'r rhan fwyaf o bobl yn ei gysylltu â theithio: twristiaeth hamdden.
text_en: Perhaps the most common type of tourism is what most people associate with traveling: Recreation tourism.

text: Dyma pan mae pobl yn mynd i le sy'n wahanol iawn i'w bywyd bob dydd i ymlacio a chael hwyl.
text_en: This is when people go to a place that is very different from their regular day-to-day life to relax and have fun.

text: Traethau, parciau thema a meysydd gwersylla yw'r lleoedd mwyaf cyffredin mae twristiaid hamdden yn eu mynychu yn aml.
text_en: Beaches, theme parks and camp grounds are often the most common places frequented by recreational tourists.

text: Os mai amcan ymweliad rhywun â lle neilltuol yw dod i wybod ei hanes a diwylliant yna mae'r math hwn o dwristiaeth yn cael ei adnabod fel twristiaeth ddiwylliannol.
text_en: If the objective of one’s visit to a particular place is to get to know its history and culture then this type of tourism is known as cultural tourism.

text: Mae twristiaid yn gallu ymweld â thirnodau gwahanol gwlad benodol neu gallent ddewis i ganolbwyntio ar un ardal yn unig.
text_en: Tourists may visit different landmarks of a particular country or they may simply opt to focus on just one area.

text: Roedd y Gwladychwyr, o weld y gweithgarwch hwn, hefyd wedi galw am filwyr ychwanegol.
text_en: The Colonists, seeing this activity, had also called for reinforcements.

text: Roedd y milwyr oedd yn atgyfnerthu'r safleoedd blaen yn cynnwys catrodau 1af a 3ydd New Hampshire o 200 o ddynion, o dan y Cyrnolau John Stark a James Reed (daeth y ddau yn gadfridogion yn ddiweddarach).
text_en: Troops reinforcing the forward positions included the 1st and 3rd New Hampshire regiments of 200 men, under Colonels John Stark and James Reed (both later became generals).

text: Cymerodd dynion Stark eu safleoedd ar hyd y ffens ar ben gogleddol safle'r Gwladychwr.
text_en: Stark's men took positions along the fence on the north end of the Colonist's position.

text: Pan agorodd llanw isel fwlch ar hyd Afon Mystic ar hyd gogledd-ddwyrain y penrhyn, fe wnaethant estyn y ffens yn gyflym â wal gerrig fer i'r gogledd yn diweddu ar ymyl y dŵr ar draeth bach.
text_en: When low tide opened a gap along the Mystic River along the northeast of the peninsula, they quickly extended the fence with a short stone wall to the north ending at the water's edge on a small beach.

text: Gosododd Gridley a Stark stanc tua 100 troedfedd (30 metr) o flaen y ffens a gorchymyn nad oedd neb yn tanio tan i'r milwyr cyffredin fynd heibio iddo.
text_en: Gridley or Stark placed a stake about 100 feet (30 m) in front of the fence and ordered that no one fire until the regulars passed it.

text: Roedd cynllun America yn dibynnu ar lansio ymosodiadau cydlynedig o dri chyfeiriad gwahanol.
text_en: The American plan relied on launching coordinated attacks from three different directions.

text: Byddai'r Cadfridog John Cadwalder yn lansio ymosodiad gwrthdyniadol yn erbyn garsiwn Prydain yn Bordentown, er mwyn atal unrhyw filwyr ychwanegol.
text_en: General John Cadwalder would launch a diversionary attack against the British garrison at Bordentown, in order to block off any reinforcements.

text: Byddai'r Cadfridog James Ewing yn cymryd 700 o filwyr ar draws yr afon yn Trenton Ferry, yn meddiannu'r bont dros Assunpink Creek ac yn atal milwyr y gelyn rhag dianc.
text_en: General James Ewing would take 700 militia across the river at Trenton Ferry, seize the bridge over the Assunpink Creek and prevent any enemy troops from escaping.

text: Byddai'r prif lu ymosod o 2,400 o ddynion yn croesi'r afon i'r gogledd o Trenton, ac yna'n rhannu'n ddau grŵp, un o dan Greene a'r llall o dan Sullivan, er mwyn lansio ymosodiad cyn y wawr.
text_en: The main assault force of 2,400 men would cross the river nine miles north of Trenton, and then split into two groups, one under Greene and one under Sullivan, in order to launch a pre-dawn attack.

text: Gyda'r newid o'r ras chwarter i hanner milltir, mae cyflymder yn dod yn llawer llai pwysig ac mae gwytnwch yn dod yn anghenraid llwyr.
text_en: With the change from the quarter to the half mile run, speed becomes of much less importance and endurance becomes an absolute necessity.

text: Wrth gwrs, mae'n rhaid fod gan redwr hanner milltir o'r safon uchaf, dyn sy'n gallu curo dau funud, gyflymder rhesymol, ond mae'n rhaid i ddycnwch gael ei feithrin ar bob cyfrif.
text_en: Of course a first-class half-miler, a man who can beat two minutes, must be possessed of a fair amount of speed, but endurance must be cultivated at all hazards.

text: Rhywfaint o redeg traws gwlad yn ystod y gaeaf, wedi'i gyfuno â gwaith campfa ar gyfer rhan uchaf y corff, yw'r paratoad gorau ar gyfer y tymor rhedeg.
text_en: Some cross country running during the winter, combined with gymnasium work for the upper part of the body, is the best preparation for the running season.

text: Ni all arferion maethyddol priodol yn unig gynhyrchu perfformiadau elitaidd, ond gallent effeithio ar les cyffredinol athletwyr ifanc yn sylweddol.
text_en: Proper nutritional practices alone cannot generate elite performances, but they can significantly affect young athletes' overall wellness.

text: Gall cynnal cydbwysedd egni iach, ymarfer arferion hydradu effeithiol, a deall agweddau amrywiol ymarferion ychwanegiadau helpu athletwyr i wella'u perfformiad a chynyddu eu mwynhad o'r gamp.
text_en: Maintaining a healthy energy balance, practicing effective hydration habits, and understanding the various aspects of supplementation practices can help athletes improve their performance and increase their enjoyment of the sport.

text: Mae rhedeg pellter canol yn gamp gymharol rad; fodd bynnag, mae nifer o gamdybiaethau ynghylch yr ychydig ddarnau o offer sydd eu hangen er mwyn cymryd rhan.
text_en: Middle distance running is a relatively inexpensive sport; however, there are many misconceptions regarding the few pieces of equipment required to participate.

text: Gellir prynu cynnyrch yn ôl yr angen, ond ni fydd y rhan fwyaf ohonynt yn cael fawr o effaith ar berfformiad, os o gwbl.
text_en: Products can be purchased as needed, but most will have little or no real impact on performance.

text: Gallai athletwyr deimlo bod yn well ganddyn nhw gynnyrch hyd yn oed pan nad yw'n cynnig unrhyw fanteision gwirioneddol.
text_en: Athletes may feel that they prefer a product even when it provides no real benefits.

text: Gellir ystyried bod yr atom yn un o flociau adeiladu sylfaenol pob sylwedd.
text_en: The atom can be considered to be one of the fundamental building blocks of all matter.

text: Mae'n endid cymhleth iawn sy'n cynnwys, yn ôl model Bohr a symleiddiwyd, niwclews canolog ag electronau'n cylchdroi o'i gwmpas, braidd yn debyg i blanedau'n cylchdroi o gwmpas yr haul - gweler Ffigur 1.
text_en: Its a very complex entity which consists, according to a simplified Bohr model, of a central nucleus orbited by electrons, somewhat similar to planets orbiting the sun - see Figure 1.1.

text: Mae'r niwclews yn cynnwys dau ronyn - niwtronau a phrotonau.
text_en: The nucleus consists of two particles - neutrons and protons.

text: Mae gan brotonau wefr drydanol bositif, ac nid oes gan niwtronau wefr. Mae gan electronau wefr drydanol negatif.
text_en: Protons have a positive electric charge while neutrons have no charge. The electrons have a negative electric charge.

text: I wirio'r dioddefwr, mae'n rhaid i chi yn gyntaf arolygu'r fan i sicrhau eich diogelwch.
text_en: To Check the victim, you must first survey the scene to ensure your safety.

text: Mae angen i chi sylwi ar safle'r dioddefwr wrth i chi nesáu ato neu ati ac unrhyw faneri coch awtomatig.
text_en: You need to notice the victim's position as you approach him or her and any automatic red flags.

text: Os cewch chi eich brifo wrth geisio helpu, gallech chi fod ond yn gwneud pethau'n waeth.
text_en: If you get hurt trying to help, you may only serve to make matters worse.

text: Fe wnaeth yr astudiaeth ganfod bod iselder, ofn ac yn creu trychineb o bopeth yn cyfryngu'r berthynas rhwng poen ac anabledd ymhlith pobl sy'n dioddef poen yng ngwaelod y cefn.
text_en: The study found that depression, fear and catastrophising mediated the relationship between pain and disability in lower back pain sufferers.

text: Dim ond effeithiau trychinebu, nid iselder ac ofn oedd yn amodol ar sesiynau strwythuredig wythnosol PA.
text_en: Only the effects of catastrophizing, not depression and fear was conditional of regular weekly structured PA sessions.

text: Roedd angen rhagor o gymorth ar y rhai oedd yn cymryd rhan mewn gweithgaredd rheolaidd yn nhermau canfyddiad o boen gan wahaniaethu rhwng gwahaniaethau poen cronig a theimlad anghyfforddus o symudiad corfforol arferol.
text_en: Those participating in regular activity required more support in terms of negative perception of pain distinguishing the differences of chronic pain and discomfort feel from normal physical movement.

text: Mae golwg, neu'r gallu i weld, yn dibynnu ar organau synhwyraidd y system weledol neu'r llygaid.
text_en: Vision, or the ability to see depends on visual system sensory organs or eyes.

text: Mae nifer o luniadau gwahanol i lygaid, gan amrywio mewn cymhlethdod yn dibynnu ar ofynion yr organeb.
text_en: There are many different constructions of eyes, ranging in complexity depending on the requirements of the organism.

text: Mae gan y gwahanol luniadau alluoedd gwahanol, maen nhw'n sensitif i donfeddi gwahanol ac yn amrywio o ran graddau craffter, maen nhw hefyd angen prosesu gwahanol i wneud synnwyr o'r mewnbwn a rhifau gwahanol i weithio i'r eithaf.
text_en: The different constructions have different capabilities, are sensitive to different wave-lengths and have differing degrees of acuity, also they require different processing to make sense of the input and different numbers to work optimally.

text: Casgliad o organebau rhywogaeth benodol o fewn ardal ddaearyddol arbennig yw poblogaeth.
text_en: A population is the collection of organisms of a particular species within a given geographic area.

text: Pan fydd pob unigolyn mewn poblogaeth yn hollol yr un fath o ran nodwedd ffenotypig benodol maen nhw'n cael eu hadnabod fel monomorffig.
text_en: When all individuals in a population are identical with regard to a particular phenotypic trait they are known as monomorphic.

text: Pan fydd yr unigolion yn dangos sawl amrywiad o nodwedd benodol maen nhw'n amryffurf.
text_en: When the individuals show several variants of a particular trait they are polymorphic.

text: Mae cytrefi morgrug heidiol yn gorymdeithio a nythu mewn cyfnodau gwahanol hefyd.
text_en: Army ant colonies march and nest in different phases as well.

text: Yn y cyfnod nomadig, mae morgrug y fyddin yn gorymdeithio yn y nos ac yn stopio i wersylla yn ystod y dydd.
text_en: In the nomadic phase, army ants march at night and stop to camp during the day.

text: Mae'r nythfa yn cychwyn cyfnod crwydrol pan fydd y bwyd ar gael yn lleihau. Yn ystod y cyfnod hwn, mae'r nythfa'n gwneud nythod dros dro sy'n cael eu newid bob dydd.
text_en: The colony begins a nomadic phase when available food has decreased. During this phase, the colony makes temporary nests that are changed everyday.

text: Mae pob un o'r terfysgoedd neu orymdeithiau nomadig hyn yn para am tua 17 diwrnod.
text_en: Each of these nomadic rampages or marches lasts for approximately 17 days.

text: Beth ydy cell? Mae'r gair cell yn dod o'r gair Lladin "cella", sy'n golygu "ystafell fechan", a chafodd ei fathu yn gyntaf gan ficrosgopydd oedd yn arsylwi strwythur corc.
text_en: What is a cell? The word cell comes from the Latin word "cella", meaning "small room", and it was first coined by a microscopist observing the structure of cork.

text: Y gell yw uned sylfaenol popeth byw, ac mae'r holl organebau wedi'u cyfansoddi o un neu ragor o gelloedd.
text_en: The cell is the basic unit of all living things, and all organisms are composed of one or more cells.

text: Mae celloedd mor sylfaenol a hanfodol i astudio bywyd, mewn gwirionedd, y cyfeirir atyn nhw'n aml fel "blociau adeiladu bywyd".
text_en: Cells are so basic and critical to the study of life, in fact, that they are often referred to as "the building blocks of life".

text: Mae'r System Nerfol yn cynnal homeostasis trwy anfon ysgogiadau nerf trwy'r corff i gadw llif y gwaed i fynd heb ei darfu.
text_en: The Nervous System maintains homeostasis by sending nerve impulses through out the body to keep the flow of blood going as well as undisturbed.

text: Gellir anfon yr ysgogiadau nerf hyn mor gyflym trwy'r corff cyfan sy'n helpu cadw'r corff yn ddiogel rhag unrhyw fygythiad posibl.
text_en: These nerve impulses can be sent so quickly throughout the body which helps keep the body safe from any potential threat.

text: Mae corwyntoedd yn taro ardal fechan o'u cymharu â stormydd gwyllt eraill, ond gallant ddinistrio popeth yn eu llwybr.
text_en: Tornadoes strike a small area compared to other violent storms, but they can destroy everything in their path.

text: Mae corwyntoedd yn codi coed o'r gwraidd, yn rhwygo byrddau oddi ar adeiladau, ac yn taflu ceir i'r awyr. Mae'r ddau y cant o gorwyntoedd mwyaf chwyrn yn para mwy na thair awr.
text_en: Tornadoes uproot trees, rip boards from buildings, and fling cars up into the sky. The most violent two percent of tornadoes last more than three hours.
